_comment: Append the moment anything enters the repo. Reconstructing this in the last week is how teams end up guessing, and a guess is what turns properly credited work into a plagiarism question.

libraries.name: three.js
libraries.used_for: Rendering, scene graph, math types. Also its add-ons (examples/jsm, same MIT licence): GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils, and the post-processing passes EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass, FXAAPass and ShaderPass (src/lighting/post.js, src/lighting/speed-fx.js)

libraries.name: Rapier (@dimforge/rapier3d-compat)
libraries.used_for: Collision detection, rigid body integration, raycasts. Vehicle dynamics are our own - see the design document, section 2.

models.name: City Track (assets/maps/CityTrack.glb)
models.author: Neon Rush team
models.used_for: Official map 1 - street circuit, generated by the team's citytrack.py (detailed version, with the layout and placement fixes listed in the map handoff). Loaded by src/levels/city.js
models.modified: Rebuilt by blender/city/citytrack.py: street cross-section, road paint, kerb blocks, 10 m clearance, start gantry, no parked cars

models.name: Grand Prix (assets/maps/GrandPrix.glb)
models.author: Neon Rush team
models.used_for: Official map 2 - full circuit. Loaded by src/levels/grandprix.js
models.modified: Rebuilt by blender/grandprix/fix_grandprix.py: Turn 1 hairpin and right-hander, hills and crest, esses, banked corners, terrain, crowds, floodlights, bridge

models.name: Mountain Track (assets/maps/MountainTrack.glb)
models.author: Neon Rush team (procedural, mountain_track.py)
models.used_for: Official map 3 - mountain climb: road, rails, kerbs, tunnel, terrain and scenery, generated in Blender from blender/mountain/mountain_track.py. Loaded by src/levels/mountain.js

textures.name: Surface detail normal maps (grain, gravel, brick, tiles, panels, rock)
textures.author: Neon Rush team
textures.used_for: Bump detail on roads, paving, facades, concrete, rock and gravel traps. Generated in code at startup from height fields; no image files

audio.name: Engine, tyre squeal, crash, rock landing and pickup (assets/audio/*.mp3)
audio.author: Generated by the Neon Rush team with ElevenLabs Sound Effects (text-to-sound)
audio.licence: ElevenLabs terms of use — generated output, used under the account's licence
audio.used_for: The sounds synthesis is worst at: the car engine (three loops at different revs, crossfaded), tyre squeal, a glancing crash, a boulder landing, and the pickup chime. Everything else in the game is still generated in code at runtime and is original work (src/core/audio.js). Loaded by src/core/sfx.js, which falls back to the synthesised version of each if a file is missing.

learned_from.name: Ben Golus, "Normal Mapping for a Triplanar Shader" (2017)
learned_from.used_for: The "whiteout" blend that combines the three projected normal-map samples with the surface normal in the triplanar projection
